name: Verdurous-Barrow
description: An ocean of dust without banks. At the edge of sight, past asteroid belt proximity, mirage-cities rise and collapse by noon, and the light turns brutal and white.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.
The ruins predate every charted civilization, and whatever built derelict space station in orbit left in a hurry. Doors seal from the outside. Nobody has explained why.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
